scope: Original mounted TransitionView callbacks, unscaled source clips, animation events and dedicated AudioSource behavior

native_behavior.OnEnable: Subscribe to TransitionController.OnSwitching and OnSwitched only
native_behavior.OnDisable: Remove both event listeners only; the separately mounted Animancer component owns its ActionOnDisable.Stop policy
native_behavior.OnSwitching_dmu: Play serialized slideIn clip with fadeDuration0 and FadeMode.FromStart2
native_behavior.OnSwitched_dmv: Play serialized slideOut clip with fadeDuration0 and FadeMode.FromStart2
native_behavior.initialize: The source field and its zero-duration original clip are retained, but none of the nine methods plays it. Attach does not invent an initialize playback.
native_behavior.SFX_public_methods: PlaySlideIn/PlayUnlock/PlaySlideOut/PlayContact are animation-event sound wrappers, not cover-clip entry points
native_behavior.SFX_order: Float Random.Range(pitch), AudioSource.pitch assignment, int Random.Range(clip index), float Random.Range(volume), AudioSource.PlayOneShot(clip,volumeScale)
native_behavior.SFX_properties: No source.Stop, source.volume assignment, source.loop assignment or reseeding. Source panelsSlideIn volume0 is preserved.
native_behavior.clip_events: slideIn emits PlaySlideIn at0.016666668 and PlayContact at0.033333335; slideOut emits PlaySlideOut at0. The serialized PlayUnlock sound has no event in these three clips.
native_behavior.curves: Original wooden panels, vignette and loading indicator curves are copied unchanged. slideOut disables root UnityEngine.UI.Image through its original m_Enabled binding and hides the internal MainContainer at0.25 seconds.

integration_order: Build/import the original hierarchy and initialize existing main UI flow first; the generic disable-all-main-children bootstrap would otherwise disable TransitionView
Construct the actual arena sequence owner, then Attach once. Attach restores the source TransitionView root active state and receives normal Unity OnEnable.
Keep the outer TransitionView active through mode/round changes. Only its original clip-controlled internal objects close/open.

Run the first Arena entrance through the same source transition sequence as later entrances. Directly spawning a first Practice skips the source Menu->Arena cover/uncover lifecycle, including the original Image raycast release.
Runner destruction still clears battle network screens through CanvasAndCamera.ccu; the cover does not substitute for that UI lifecycle.
limits: Native oracle observes subscription boundaries, clip/fade arguments and actual SFX instructions with bounded RNG/audio/Animancer services. A real Unity animation/raycast/cover comparison remains pending Root's integration run.

Animancer is represented by an unscaled PlayableGraph using the unchanged original clips. FromStart resets playback to0; the original engine is responsible for evaluating curves and dispatching the retained animation events.
The helper's graph stop on disable represents the separate mounted Animancer ActionOnDisable0 policy. It is not an additional TransitionView callback requirement.
The source initialize clip is exported as evidence, not silently executed to compensate for a skipped bootstrap transition.
No Preview/HUD/UIFlow/Timing or generated active-project files were edited for this component.
